sections.title: Charged Attack
sections.description:
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, the power of Hydro will continually accumulate on the arrow. After fully charging, Sigewinne will periodically fire slow-moving Mini-Stration Bubbles toward the target, dealing Hydro DMG. When released, an arrow imbued with torrential energy will deal Hydro DMG to the opponent hit.

sections.title: Plunging Attack
sections.description: Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

_curatorNotes: tickCap 5 / 8 at C1, MIRRORING the damage series on this summon (tick-cap round, 2026-08-18): gcsim bounces the bubble once per bubbleHitLimit and each bounce is one task, so the heal and the damage are the SAME tick and must draw the same number of markers. Leaving this uncapped would put 4 heal markers beside 5 damage markers on one summon.

Bolstering Bubblebalm damage tick authored 2026-08-17 (gauge-round residue: geometry-only summon that gcsim measures dealing damage). gcsim skill.go bolsteringBubblebalm() queues c.skillAttackInfo on every bounce, re-scheduling itself at bubbleHitInterval=107f → interval 1.783s; the first bounce is the task added at skillHitmark, which IS this summon's spawnsAt (press 35f) → firstTickDelay 0. generateSkillSnapshot(): FlatDmg = bolsteringBubblebalmDMG[TalentLvlSkill] * c.MaxHP() → stat 'hp'; index 9 (TL10) = 0.04104 → scaling 4.104, cross-checked against sidecar row 'Bolstering Bubblebalm DMG' col 10 = '4.10% Max HP'. Element Hydro, Durability 25 (1U).

icdGate authored 2026-08-17 (ICD-group round b), CORRECTING this note's original claim that ICDGroupSigewinne was standard: its table entry (pkg/core/attacks/icd_groups.dm.go) is a 120f reset window in which only the FIRST hit applies. Measured 3/5 applied, which standard also gives at this 107f interval — which is how the group came to be recorded as standard when only its EFFECT on one fixture was observable. ⚠️ The lesson is the round's: an applied count says THAT the default is wrong, never what is right.

Tick COUNT is bubbleHitLimit (sigewinne.go: 5 base, +3 at C1 → 8) and is already expressed by the summon's duration 7.1s plus the C1 durationModifier +5.4s; the CADENCE is unchanged at C1, so no constellation-gated second series is authored. Hold-tier DMG bonus NOT authored: bubbleTierDamageMod() adds currentBubbleTier*bubbleTierBuff (0.05) DmgP to this exact attack and bubbleTierLoseTask drops a tier per bounce, so only the earliest bounces of h1E/h2E get +5%/+10% — the same decaying-per-tick gap already flagged for the tier healing bonus in the caveat. Interval written as 1.783 (107/60 to 3dp) rather than the sibling heal effect's legacy 1.78; same gcsim constant.

tickCap 5 / 8 at C1 (tick-cap round, 2026-08-18): gcsim sigewinne.go sets `c.bubbleHitLimit = 5` and `if c.Base.Cons >= 1 { c.bubbleHitLimit += 3 }` - an explicit COUNT, which is what the geometry note above was already expressing indirectly through the C1 durationModifier. Measured 5 at C0 and 8 at C6. The C1 override is required: with a flat cap of 5 the C1 case would regress from the 8 it already derives.

abilities.caveat: Not modeled: the one-time self-heal (50% Max HP) when the bubble stops bouncing, the held-cast healing boost on early bounces (+5% / +10%), and Bond of Life from the skill's Sourcewater Droplets.
_curatorNotes: Per-bounce team heal authored 2026-07-12 as a summonTick heal on all three Bolstering Bubblebalm summons (base E + h1E + h2E variants — AbilityVariant.summons replaces the base array, so each needs its own copy). Kuki Sanctifying Ring summonTick-heal shape. gcsim skill.go bubbleHealing() heals every party member EXCEPT Sigewinne (loop skips other.Index()==c.Index()) → target 'teamExcludingSelf'. Cadence: bubbleHitInterval=107f (interval 1.78s); first bounce fires at skillHitmark (=summon spawnsAt: press 35f / shortHold 66f / hold 90f), i.e. delay 0 from spawn → firstTickDelay:0. TL10 (index 9): bolsteringBubblebalmHealingPct[9]=0.0504 (5.04% Max HP) + bolsteringBubblebalmHealingFlat[9]=593.2341 (sidecar 'Bolstering Bubblebalm Healing' col 10 = '5.04% Max HP+593'). No EM/other-stat rider, so no flatScaling.

Final-bounce self heal NOT authored as an effect: gcsim bubbleFinalHealing() heals ONLY Sigewinne for finalBounceHealing[9]=0.5 (50% Max HP), once, on the last bounce (tick==bubbleHitLimit-1: base tick 4, C1 tick 7). No summon-end / final-tick trigger primitive exists to place a one-shot heal at the end of the bounce chain — documented in the caveat instead. This is the source of the fixture's target:'team' (per-bounce is teammates-only; Sigewinne is covered by the final heal).

Hold-tier healing bonus NOT authored: gcsim passes Bonus: c.Stat(Heal) + currentBubbleTier*bubbleTierBuff (bubbleTierBuff=0.05) → +5% healing per size tier (Short Hold tier 1 = +5%, Hold tier 2 = +10%), and bubbleTierLoseTask drops one tier per bounce so only the earliest bounce(s) get it. No decaying per-tick summon-heal-bonus primitive; flagged in caveat.
Bolstering Bubblebalm mobility omitted: bubble bounces between enemies — not stationary (anchored to a world point) and not caster-following. Reviewer to decide mobility representation.

Bond of Life / Sourcewater Droplets not authored: skill spawns 2 Sourcewater Droplets near Sigewinne at frame skillCDStart+4 (press=20f, shortHold=44f, hold=70f). Each droplet Sigewinne collects grants Bond of Life worth 10% MaxHP (BoLPctPerDroplet=0.1 in dash.go). When Bond clears, Sigewinne regains 1 Energy per 2000 HP cleared, up to 5 Energy (hpDebtEnergyRatio=2000, energyBondClearMod in skill.go). Burst also absorbs up to 2 nearby Sourcewater Droplets on cast. Energy effect not authored — reviewer to wire.

Arkhe: Ousia (Spiritbreath Thorn) not authored: each bubble bounce calls surgingBladeTask which fires Ousia-aligned Hydro DMG at skillAlignedHitmark=40f with 10s ICD (skillAlignedICD=600f), FlatDmg = surgingBladeDMG[talentLv] * MaxHP (skill.go). Effect not yet authored — needs reviewer pass.

Bubble bounce mechanics: base 5 bounces (bubbleHitLimit=5) at 107f intervals (bubbleHitInterval=107). C1 adds 3 bounces (bubbleHitLimit+=3 → 8). Duration = (bubbleHitLimit-1)*107/60: base 4*107/60=7.1s, C1 7*107/60=12.5s (+5.4s). First bounce at spawnsAt per variant (press=35f, shortHold=66f, hold=90f).
Schema gap — Short Hold variant (h1E) cooldownStartDelay=40f (skillShortHoldCDStart=40 in skill.go). AbilityVariant has no cooldownStartDelay field; reviewer to extend schema.
Schema gap — Hold variant (h2E) cooldownStartDelay=66f (skillHoldCDStart=66 in skill.go). AbilityVariant has no cooldownStartDelay field; reviewer to extend schema.
abilities.description:
Blows a Bolstering Bubblebalm that can stimulate blood flow and help patients drift off to sleep using a bubblegun specially made in the Fortress of Meropide.
Bolstering Bubblebalms will bounce between nearby opponents, dealing Hydro DMG based on Sigewinne's max HP to opponents it hits. When it bounces, it will restore HP to all nearby party members except Sigewinne herself. The amount healed is based on Sigewinne's max HP.
After bouncing 5 times, the Bolstering Bubblebalm will disappear and restore HP to Sigewinne based on her max HP value.
When no opponents are present, the Bolstering Bubblebalm will bounce nearby. Only one Bolstering Bubblebalm created by a Sigewinne may exist at once.
When Held, the Bolstering Bubblebalm can be boosted to an even bigger size.

Hold
Enter Aiming Mode to begin blowing an even bigger, even more breathtaking Bolstering Bubblebalm!
The Bolstering Bubblebalm will grow bigger the longer the skill is Held, until it grows up to two tiers in size. Each tier it grows increases its DMG by 5% and healing by 5%. When a Bolstering Bubblebalm bounces, it will drop down a tier in size, until it returns to being a normal Bolstering Bubblebalm.
After weaker opponents are hit by big Bolstering Bubblebalms, they will be imprisoned and will be unable to move.

In addition, 2 Sourcewater Droplets will be created near Sigewinne when she uses this Skill. Each Sourcewater Droplet Sigewinne collects will grant her a Bond of Life worth 10% of her Max HP.
When Sigewinne's Bond of Life is cleared, she regains 1 Elemental Energy for every 2,000 HP worth of the Bond of Life that was cleared. Sigewinne can regain up to 5 Elemental Energy in this way.

Arkhe: Ousia
Bolstering Bubblebalms periodically call down a Surging Blade on the position they hit, dealing Ousia-aligned Hydro DMG based on Sigewinne's max HP.

value.description: +80 flat Skill DMG per 1,000 of Sigewinne's Max HP above 30,000, up to 2,800

passives.caveat: Each off-field teammate's Skill hit spends 1 of the 10 Convalescence stacks granted at cast — once they're used up, the extra Skill DMG stops even while the window is still shown.
_curatorNotes: Inherited manual trigger on HydroP effect — likely onCast(skill). gcsim a1Self() called directly within Skill() at ascension>=1, applying 8% HydroP and 10 Convalescence stacks for 18s (skillCD*60 frames).

Convalescence buff authored 2026-07-28 (capability sweep): gcsim sigewinne/asc.go:14-16 (flatConvalescenceIncrease=80/1000, flatConvalescenceCap=2800, baseConvalescenceHP=30000), asc.go:42-60 (10 stacks on E cast for 18s; each nearby off-field non-Sigewinne party member's Elemental Skill hit consumes 1 stack, adding flat DMG = min(2800, max(MaxHP-30000,0)*0.08)). The (MaxHP-30000) offset is not expressible as a BuffValue scaling ratio, hence type:'unknown' (Mona Waterborne Destiny precedent). C1 modifies: 100/1000 per HP above 30k, cap 3500 — not separately authored.

gainStacks/consumeStacks pair deliberately not authored: the buff value is unknown-form (not perStack), so a stack lane could not link to the displayed value and would add tracking without changing the render; the 10-stack depletion is caveated instead.
passives.description: Sigewinne grants herself the "Semi-Strict Bedrest" effect for 18s after using Rebound Hydrotherapy: Sigewinne gains an 8% Hydro DMG Bonus and 10 stacks of Convalescence. When the Elemental Skills of your nearby off-field party members other than Sigewinne deal DMG, consume 1 stack of Convalescence, and increase the DMG dealt by this instance of Elemental Skill DMG. Every 1,000 Max HP Sigewinne has above 30,000 increases the DMG by 80. The maximum DMG increase for Elemental Skills that can be gained in this way is 2,800.
